constellations.desc: After using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color>, Zibai will immediately gain 100 {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color>{/LINK}, and the max number of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> usages per <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color> mode is increased to 5 times.\nAdditionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.

constellations.desc: When in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1262101}The Selenic Adeptus Descends{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. constellations.desc: While in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> hits opponents, Zibai will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>"Scattermoon Splendor"</color> effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11265}Tri-Sphere Eminence{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not

constellations.desc: While Zibai is in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, her <color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color> gain rate is increased by 50%.\nAdditionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevate</color>{/LINK} the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.

passives.desc: When casting the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color>, or when nearby party members trigger Moondrift Harmony, Zibai gains the <color=#FFD780FF>Selenic Descent</color> effect for 4s: The DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color>{/LINK} is increased by 60% of Zibai's DEF.
passives.name: The Selenic Adeptus Descends

passives.desc: Other <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.
passives.name: Layered Peaks Pierce the Clouds

passives.desc: When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Zibai has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.\n\nAdditionally, when Zibai is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.
passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: The Coursing Sun and Moon

passives.desc: At night (18:00 – 06:00), when not in combat, restore 1 Elemental Energy to Zibai every 2 seconds.\nThis effect does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.name: Moonlit Flower Forest

hyperlinks.description:
After using the Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest, Zibai will change to this mode. This mode lasts at most 15s and has the following properties:
· Normal and Charged Attacks are converted into Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions.
· The Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest will also be converted to the Elemental Skill Spirit Steed's Stride: When Zibai has at least 70 Phase Shift Radiance, she can consume 70 Phase Shift Radiance to unleash Spirit Steed's Stride and cause two instances of Geo DMG. The second instance will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

A maximum of 100 Phase Shift Radiance points can be accrued, and Zibai can accumulate them in the following ways:
· She gains 10 points every second she is in the Lunar Phase Shift mode.
· She gains 5 points when hitting an opponent with her Normal Attacks. She can gain Phase Shift Radiance points in this way once every 0.5s.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
When nearby party members trigger Lunar-Crystallize, they will also accrue 35 Phase Shift Radiance points for Zibai. Points can be gained this way once every 4s. Unleashing the special elemental skill Spirit Steed's Stride will reset the CD for Phase Shift Radiance gained this way.

Zibai will leave this mode after unleashing Spirit Steed's Stride 4 times, or when the skill's duration ends.
hyperlinks.name: Lunar Phase Shift

People often say time passes as swiftly as "a white colt through a crevice." Children often ask if the colt might fail to pass through so quickly were it any fatter. const1.description: 施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}天地忽然身{/LINK}</color>后，兹白会立即积攒100点{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>「时隙浮光」</color>{/LINK}，且<color=#FFD780FF>「月转时隙」</color>模式下<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>的最大可用次数增加至5次。\n此外，每次切换至「月转时隙」模式后，初次施放灵驹飞踏时，第二段攻击造成的月结晶反应伤害提升220%。
const1.name: 出勃然而入寥然

const2.description: 处于{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>「月转时隙」</color>{/LINK}模式下时，队伍中附近的所有角色造成的月结晶反应伤害提升30%。\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：突破天赋<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1262101}月下素娥降仙{/LINK}</color>的效果获得提升：<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>第二段攻击造成的伤害进一步提升，提升值相当于兹白防御力的550%；该效果需要解锁突破天赋月下素娥降仙。
const2.name: 化于生而死于尸

const3.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}天地忽然身{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const3.name: 解天韬而堕其帙

const4.description: 处于{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>「月转时隙」</color>{/LINK}模式下时，兹白的普通攻击连击段数不会重置，且<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>命中敌人时，兹白将获得<color=#FFD780FF>「月涣华」</color>效果：下一次进行普通攻击时，第四段额外攻击将造成相当于原本250%的月结晶反应伤害。
const4.name: 魂魄往而身从之

const5.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11265}三垣威仪法{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 明见无值至不论

const6.description: 处于{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>「月转时隙」</color>{/LINK}模式下时，兹白积攒<color=#FFD780FF>「时隙浮光」</color>的效率提升50%。\n此外，<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>将转为消耗所有的「时隙浮光」，基于消耗的「时隙浮光」超过70点的部分，每额外消耗1点「时隙浮光」，都会使本次灵驹飞踏与接下来3秒内兹白造成的月结晶反应伤害{LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>擢升</color>{/LINK}1.6%。该效果无法叠加。
const6.name: 天地忽如一远行

hyperlinks.description: 特殊的伤害提升效果，与其他的伤害提升效果分别独立计算。
hyperlinks.name: 擢升

hyperlinks.description:
施放元素战技天地忽然身后，兹白将切换至该模式。该模式至多持续15秒，并具有以下特性：
·进行普通攻击与重击时，将转为造成无法被附魔覆盖的岩元素伤害；
·元素战技天地忽然身将会被替换为特殊的元素战技灵驹飞踏：当兹白拥有至少70点「时隙浮光」时，兹白可以消耗70点「时隙浮光」，施放灵驹飞踏，造成两次岩元素伤害，其中的第二段伤害视为月结晶反应伤害。

「时隙浮光」上限为100点，兹白可以通过以下方式积攒「时隙浮光」：
·处于「月转时隙」模式下时，每秒积攒10点「时隙浮光」；
·普通攻击命中敌人时，会积攒5点「时隙浮光」，每0.5秒至多通过这种方式为兹白积攒一次「时隙浮光」。

月兆·满辉 
队伍中附近的角色触发月结晶反应时，也会为兹白积攒35点「时隙浮光」，每4秒至多通过这种方式为兹白积攒一次「时隙浮光」，施放特殊元素战技灵驹飞踏将会重置通过这种方式积攒「时隙浮光」的冷却时间。

施放4次灵驹飞踏后，或持续时间结束时，兹白将退出该模式。
hyperlinks.name: 月转时隙

info.description: 璃月传说中的白马仙人，其名为兹白，璃月仙话中最神秘的一位。
info.name: 兹白
info.title: 驹隙隐泉

p1.description: 施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}天地忽然身{/LINK}</color>时，或队伍中附近的角色触发月笼谐奏时，兹白将获得持续4秒的<color=#FFD780FF>「太阴降」</color>效果：{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>{/LINK}第二段攻击造成的伤害提升，提升值相当于兹白防御力的60%。
p1.name: 月下素娥降仙

p2.description: 队伍中每存在一名元素类型为<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素</color>的其他角色，都会使兹白的防御力提升15%；队伍中每存在一名元素类型为<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>的其他角色，都会使兹白的元素精通提升60点。
p2.name: 叠嶂峦岫出云

p3.description: 队伍中的角色触发水元素结晶反应时，将转为触发月结晶反应，且基于兹白的防御力，提升队伍中角色造成的月结晶反应的基础伤害：每100点防御力都将提升0.7%月结晶反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升14%伤害。\n\n此外，兹白在队伍中时，队伍的<color=#FFD780FF>月兆</color>将会上升一级。
p3.name: 月兆祝赐·浮明若流

p4.description: 在夜间（18时至6时），不处于战斗状态下时，每2秒为兹白恢复1点元素能量。\n该效果在秘境、征讨领域、深境螺旋中无效。
p4.name: 花林如霰

elementalburst.description: 兹白转起青玄乘阳华盖，造成两次岩元素伤害，其中的第二段伤害视为月结晶反应伤害。 施放时，若兹白处于{LINK#N11260001}「月转时隙」{/LINK}模式下，则本次「月转时隙」模式的持续时间还会延长1.7秒。 据说很久以前有足以点亮整夜的贼星迫近，世人曾在那时窥得此法宝的华光一眼。
elementalburst.name: 三垣威仪法

elementalskill.description: 唤起旧日权能的片影，切换至{LINK#N11260001}「月转时隙」{/LINK}模式。 在该模式下，兹白进行普通攻击与重击时，将转为造成无法被附魔覆盖的岩元素伤害，并可以通过不同的方式，积攒特殊的「时隙浮光」；兹白可以消耗「时隙浮光」，施放特殊的元素战技灵驹飞踏。 月兆·满辉 处于「月转时隙」模式下时，兹白进行普通攻击时，第四段攻击将额外造成一次岩元素伤害，该伤害视为月结晶反应伤害。 世人常述光阴易逝如白驹过隙，孩童常问若白驹胖一点是不是就没法那么快过隙了，她听闻此事后神色奇怪：「过隙是一种身法，与胖瘦有什么干系？」
elementalskill.name: 天地忽然身

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多四段的连续剑击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，瞬间向前方挥出两剑。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 金铗点桂

constellations.desc: After using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color>, Zibai will immediately gain 100 {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color>{/LINK}, and the max number of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> usages per <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color> mode is increased to 5 times.\nAdditionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.
constellations.name: Burst Forth With Vigor, But Enter in Silence

constellations.desc: When in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1262101}The Selenic Adeptus Descends{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Selenic Adeptus Descends."
constellations.name: At Birth Are Souls Born, and in Death Leave But Husks

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Free From Constraints and Worldly Ties

constellations.desc: While in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> hits opponents, Zibai will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>"Scattermoon Splendor"</color> effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
constellations.name: The Spirit Passes, Then Form Follows

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11265}Tri-Sphere Eminence{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not

constellations.desc: While Zibai is in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, her <color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color> gain rate is increased by 50%.\nAdditionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevate</color>{/LINK} the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.
constellations.name: The World, A Journey in Passing

passives.desc: When casting the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color>, or when nearby party members trigger Moondrift Harmony, Zibai gains the <color=#FFD780FF>Selenic Descent</color> effect for 4s: The DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color>{/LINK} is increased by 60% of Zibai's DEF.
passives.name: The Selenic Adeptus Descends

passives.desc: Other <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.
passives.name: Layered Peaks Pierce the Clouds

passives.desc: When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Zibai has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.\n\nAdditionally, when Zibai is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.
passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: The Coursing Sun and Moon

passives.desc: At night (18:00 – 06:00), when not in combat, restore 1 Elemental Energy to Zibai every 2 seconds.\nThis effect does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.name: Moonlit Flower Forest

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Golden Blade's Petaled Touch

skills.desc:
Summoning a shadow of her former powers, she switches to the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode.
In this mode, Zibai's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks will deal <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by other infusions, and she can accrue special <color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color> through different methods. Zibai can consume Phase Shift Radiance to unleash the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>
While in the <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color> mode, when Zibai performs Normal Attacks, the fourth attack will deal an additional instance of <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color>, which is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
skills.name: Heaven and Earth Made Manifest

skills.desc: Zibai operates the Jadelight Canopy, dealing two instances of <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color>, with the second damage instance being considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.\nWhen cast, if Zibai is in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK}, the duration of the current Lunar Phase Shift will extend by an additional 1.7s.
skills.name: Tri-Sphere Eminence

constellations.desc: 施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}天地忽然身{/LINK}</color>后，兹白会立即积攒100点{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>「时隙浮光」</color>{/LINK}，且<color=#FFD780FF>「月转时隙」</color>模式下<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>的最大可用次数增加至5次。\n此外，每次切换至「月转时隙」模式后，初次施放灵驹飞踏时，第二段攻击造成的月结晶反应伤害提升220%。
constellations.name: 出勃然而入寥然

constellations.desc: 处于{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>「月转时隙」</color>{/LINK}模式下时，队伍中附近的所有角色造成的月结晶反应伤害提升30%。\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：突破天赋<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1262101}月下素娥降仙{/LINK}</color>的效果获得提升：<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>第二段攻击造成的伤害进一步提升，提升值相当于兹白防御力的550%；该效果需要解锁突破天赋月下素娥降仙。
constellations.name: 化于生而死于尸

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}天地忽然身{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 解天韬而堕其帙

constellations.desc: 处于{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>「月转时隙」</color>{/LINK}模式下时，兹白的普通攻击连击段数不会重置，且<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>命中敌人时，兹白将获得<color=#FFD780FF>「月涣华」</color>效果：下一次进行普通攻击时，第四段额外攻击将造成相当于原本250%的月结晶反应伤害。
constellations.name: 魂魄往而身从之

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11265}三垣威仪法{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 明见无值至不论

constellations.desc: 处于{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>「月转时隙」</color>{/LINK}模式下时，兹白积攒<color=#FFD780FF>「时隙浮光」</color>的效率提升50%。\n此外，<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>将转为消耗所有的「时隙浮光」，基于消耗的「时隙浮光」超过70点的部分，每额外消耗1点「时隙浮光」，都会使本次灵驹飞踏与接下来3秒内兹白造成的月结晶反应伤害{LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>擢升</color>{/LINK}1.6%。该效果无法叠加。
constellations.name: 天地忽如一远行

passives.desc: 施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}天地忽然身{/LINK}</color>时，或队伍中附近的角色触发月笼谐奏时，兹白将获得持续4秒的<color=#FFD780FF>「太阴降」</color>效果：{LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>{/LINK}第二段攻击造成的伤害提升，提升值相当于兹白防御力的60%。
passives.name: 月下素娥降仙

passives.desc: 队伍中每存在一名元素类型为<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素</color>的其他角色，都会使兹白的防御力提升15%；队伍中每存在一名元素类型为<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>的其他角色，都会使兹白的元素精通提升60点。
passives.name: 叠嶂峦岫出云

passives.desc: 队伍中的角色触发水元素结晶反应时，将转为触发月结晶反应，且基于兹白的防御力，提升队伍中角色造成的月结晶反应的基础伤害：每100点防御力都将提升0.7%月结晶反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升14%伤害。\n\n此外，兹白在队伍中时，队伍的<color=#FFD780FF>月兆</color>将会上升一级。
passives.name: 月兆祝赐·浮明若流

passives.desc: 在夜间（18时至6时），不处于战斗状态下时，每2秒为兹白恢复1点元素能量。\n该效果在秘境、征讨领域、深境螺旋中无效。
passives.name: 花林如霰

在该模式下，兹白进行普通攻击与重击时，将转为造成无法被附魔覆盖的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>，并可以通过不同的方式，积攒特殊的<color=#FFD780FF>「时隙浮光」</color>；兹白可以消耗「时隙浮光」，施放特殊的元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>灵驹飞踏</color>。
